_nguon: EN-ALL GĐ 3c — bản phủ tiếng Anh cho lời sao hạn Cửu Diệu + Bát hạn dùng trong hỏi đáp Huyền học (hoidap/chung.muc_sao_han). Tên sao / hạn: mẫu câu `hoi.sh.sao.*`, `hoi.sh.han.*`. Lời trung tính bằng hành vi, như bản Việt. Ban biên tập viết từ nghĩa.
cau_co_dinh: Year stars are a folk custom set by East Asian age and sex — the same for everyone of the same age, not worked out from your own birth date or chart. The system does not guide rituals or recommend practitioners or objects; if your family keeps a New Year custom, treat it as a time to come together.

La Hầu.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a year to talk less, listen more and keep your papers in order; gossip tends to grow bigger than the facts.
viec: Whenever you are about to discuss someone who is not there, ask that person directly instead.
Tidy one drawer of important papers and make copies.
Before replying to a message while annoyed, sleep on it.
La Hầu.tu_soi: What have you said lately that you wish you had kept to yourself?

Thổ Tú.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a year of a heavier heart and more brooding, with household matters taking more effort than usual.
viec: Take one phone-free walk a week.
Break housework into small tasks and tick each one off.
Tell someone close what is weighing on you.
Thổ Tú.tu_soi: What are you carrying alone that you could share?

Thuỷ Diệu.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a year to be careful with your words and around water when travelling; feelings run high.
viec: On boats or at the sea, wear a life jacket and do not go alone after dark.
Say important things in person rather than by message.
Keep a notebook of what you have promised others.
Thuỷ Diệu.tu_soi: Which recent promise have you not kept yet?

Thái Bạch.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a year to hold on to money, cut impulse buying and check carefully before handing money to anyone.
viec: Set aside an emergency fund you do not touch.
Wait three days before any big purchase.
When you lend money, put it in writing, even with friends.
Thái Bạch.tu_soi: Which purchase last year do you regret most, and why did you decide so fast?

Thái Dương.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a bright year for work, when you are more likely to be noticed; use it to start what you have long planned.
viec: Pick one long-planned project and start it this month.
Take on a task whose results people will see.
Look after your energy: if you work more, sleep enough.
Thái Dương.tu_soi: What have you planned for a long time and still not started?

Vân Hán.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a year of hastiness and sharp words; slow down a beat in whatever you do.
viec: When you feel heated, leave the room for five minutes, then come back.
Read papers and contracts in full before signing.
Exercise once a week to let off steam.
Vân Hán.tu_soi: The last time you lost your temper, what really annoyed you?

Kế Đô.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a year of worry and vague sadness, when family matters need more attention.
viec: Call family regularly, not only when something is wrong.
Sleep enough and read less news at night.
When you worry, write down three small things you can do right away.
Kế Đô.tu_soi: Which of your worries lately is real, and which is only imagined?

Thái Âm.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a calm year, good for home, family and health; women in particular are reminded to look after their energy.
viec: Get a routine health check early in the year.
Fix one thing at home you have left alone for a long time.
Keep one screen-free evening a week for family.
Thái Âm.tu_soi: Who at home needs someone to ask how they are, and no one has?

Mộc Đức.nghia: Folk custom reads this as a smooth year when help comes more easily; widen your circle and learn something new.
viec: Send a thank-you to someone who helped you this past year.
Sign up to learn a skill you have wanted for a long time.
Meet one new person each month.
Mộc Đức.tu_soi: Who would you like to stay in touch with but have not seen for a long time?

Huỳnh Tuyền.nghia: Old custom calls this a heavy phase and reminds you to keep your strength and routines; in everyday terms, a year to go slowly and not take on big new loads.
viec: Get your routine health check; do not put it off.
Do not take on extra work just because saying no feels awkward.
Keep one full day off each week.
Huỳnh Tuyền.tu_soi: What care for yourself are you putting off?

Tam Kheo.nghia: Old custom links this phase to arms, legs and getting around; in everyday terms, take care with exercise, climbing and long trips.
viec: Warm up properly before sport.
On long trips, leave early and do not drive when tired.
Check safety gear, ladders and shoes before using them.
Tam Kheo.tu_soi: Which of your travel habits do people close to you keep reminding you about?

Ngũ Mộ.nghia: Old custom links this phase to spending; in everyday terms, keep an emergency fund and cut what you do not need.
viec: Write down every expense for one month.
Wait three days before buying anything big.
Set aside an amount you do not touch.
Ngũ Mộ.tu_soi: What do you pay for regularly that you no longer need?

Thiên Tinh.nghia: Old custom links this phase to gossip and paperwork; in everyday terms, be clear in what you say and in contracts.
viec: Put every important agreement in writing.
Do not discuss people who are not there.
Read everything before you sign.
Thiên Tinh.tu_soi: Which of your agreements is only a spoken promise right now?

Toán Tận.nghia: Old custom calls this a heavy phase for money and energy; in everyday terms, hold on to money, look after yourself and avoid big risks.
viec: Do not invest in anything you do not understand.
Get your routine health check.
Break big tasks into small steps.
Toán Tận.tu_soi: What are you rushing that could go more slowly?

Thiên La.nghia: Old custom links this phase to tiredness and getting tangled up; in everyday terms, a year of stress and misunderstandings with people close to you.
viec: Sleep enough and cut late-night work.
When things are tense at home, say one thing you need instead of bringing up old issues.
Spend one session a week on something you enjoy.
Thiên La.tu_soi: Who are you tense with but have not said so?

Địa Võng.nghia: Old custom links this phase to entanglements and a damaged name; in everyday terms, protect your reputation and be clear from the start.
viec: Promise little, deliver in full.
Do not sign or put your name down on someone else's behalf.
Agree your part of the work before you begin.
Địa Võng.tu_soi: Which recent promise have you not managed to keep?

Diêm Vương.nghia: Old custom links this phase to news from afar and to relatives; in everyday terms, give family more attention and visit home more often.
viec: Visit or call your parents regularly.
Check in with relatives who live far away.
Look after your energy; do not stay up late night after night.
Diêm Vương.tu_soi: Which relative have you not checked on for a long time?
